points.text: Single-event accuracy below multi-event, unlike baselines; method may over-complicate simple questions
Too few temporal GraphRAG baselines
Lack of in-depth experiments
Limitations of the model not explained
Apriori-based entity typing may fail on sparse/noisy relations and long-tail graphs
Template-generated QA may align with rule graph, overstating gains; no out-of-template tests
Retrieval latency, memory and rule-graph build time not quantified
Static entity labels ignore temporal dynamics of entity roles
Baselines omit prominent LLM+KG approaches
Recent temporal RAG works not discussed
MDL graph summarization dense; needs intuition or illustrative example
Fixed equal weighting of coverage/time and Hamming terms cannot adapt to query types
Scalability to million-event TKGs unclear given Apriori mining
No runtime/memory comparison on large graphs or complexity analysis
Method does not enforce temporal constraints; time-consistency claims unsupported
No analysis showing retrieved events are more time-consistent
Transition matrix edge weights never defined
Unclear why propagation over type-level rule nodes favours correct time
L_cov formula contradicts stated cost behaviour
Edge acceptance criterion ΔL<0 seemingly never satisfiable; MDL ill-posed
MDL edge selection effect not demonstrated; rule-graph size/sparsity unreported
Greedy fixed-order edge selection makes result order-dependent
Ablations omit MDL selection, temporal term, labeling, K_type, Hamming threshold
Token reduction stems from small top-10 context, not rule graph; no matched budget
Offline construction costs unreported; deployment simplicity claim unbacked
Retrieval latency high and unexplained
No discussion of updating rule graph as TKG grows
Missing simple time-filtering or time-aware reranking baseline
No comparison to established TKGQA methods on same benchmarks
Very low absolute numbers suggest evaluation setting is the bottleneck
Baseline tuning, context sizes and Hit@k extraction undescribed
No variance, confidence intervals or significance; small gaps
Hyperparameters chosen on test-set sensitivity; no validation split
Puzzling single vs multi-event results; no per-type breakdown or failure analysis
Retrieval recall/precision against gold evidence never reported
No-rule ablation below best static baseline not discussed
Hit@k conflated with LLM generation quality
Backbone-robustness claim made without varying baseline backbones
Limited novelty: components borrowed from KGist, HippoRAG, GenTKG
Only template questions over structured KGs; generalization untested
Possible test-period leakage into rule graph on Forecast
Presentation issues: undefined acronym, deferred definitions, mixed algorithm, terminology
